name: Vinayak Polycon International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Vinayak Polycon International Ltd is a manufacturer of plastic bottles and jars.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VPIL is in the business of manufacturing and 
trading of PET items which are 100% recyclable & eco-friendly, lightweight, Transparent, Non-Breakable, Reusable, Non-toxic & Food grade, BPA (Bisphenol) free 
products like:
a) PET Bottles
b) PET Jars
c) PET Preforms
d) PP Caps 
e) Lids, etc.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 65.2 to 40.7 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.34% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.23% over last 3 years.
